preconditions.description: The number of points n must be between 1 and 30.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 10**9 and 0 <= y <= 10**9 for x, y in points)
preconditions.description: All coordinates of the points must be within the range 0 to 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must be four integers representing the coordinates of the line separating the points.

postconditions.expression: all(color in {'black', 'white'} for color in colors)
postconditions.description: The colors of the points must be either 'black' or 'white'.
The number of colors reported must match the number of points.
